latency_protocol: 100 invokes, random input, tflite_runtime in edgetpu_ros image; families/segmentation/line_seg/bench.sh
ratio_semantics:
param - pruned

pct means the FULL MODEL lost P% of its parameters
what: The four deep line_seg_w96 rungs that sit below ~1 MiB of parameters. They are the applicability limit of the weight-transfer latency law fitted in results/line_seg/param_ladder_oncar.json: all four are fully on-chip, so the law has only its on-chip term left, and it under-predicts because compute - not transfer - is now the binding cost.
latency_law: lat_ms = 2.256*offchip_mib + 0.915*onchip_mib + 0.852 (fitted on the 30 rows of param_ladder_oncar.json by results/latency_law/fit_latency_law.py; refit 2026-08-22 onto the litert-torch tpu_ms_mean column -- this file previously carried the pre-refit 2.260/0.917/0.861)
reading: Measured 1.383-2.097 ms against predicted 0.996-1.602 ms: the law under-predicts by 0.387-0.524 ms across all four. Use it as a weight-transfer model where transfer dominates, not as a general latency model.

int8_iou_by_export_path.protocol: <upstream>/training/eval_int8_lane_seg.py via families/segmentation/line_seg/publish.sh: contiguous-block held-out split, native ROI resolution, IoU over 38 TRACK val frames, misfire rate over 58 FLOOR val frames, int8 graph on CPU.
int8_iou_by_export_path.what: -95 and -99 were re-quantized through the litert-torch + ai-edge-quantizer path on 2026-08-28 and re-scored on the artifact that is now shipped. -92 and -97 still have onnx2tf builds only and their figures are unchanged.
int8_iou_by_export_path.control: The same command, same venv, same session, run first against the onnx2tf graphs returned 0.5586 and 0.5457, reproducing the pre-existing figures exactly. The delta below is between export paths, not between setups.
int8_iou_by_export_path.finding: The export path costs at most 0.0001 IoU on the two rungs where both were measured, and no misfire. Consistent with the byte side: the litert int8 file is a constant 11.72 KiB larger (metadata) and the compiled on-chip footprint is identical, 535.75 KiB and 150.25 KiB.
